scope: Bounded opt-in linear lookup observations only; no production lookup/value/field cache. Full reports and PNGs remain in process memory. Filename/function metadata contains no vendor script body. Shared-machine on/off timing is not causal overhead without independent conditions/order evidence.

lookup_distributions.scope: Exact native.param lookup counts while profiling is enabled. Hit positions are one-based; comparison counts derive from the first hit or list length on a miss. Length/hit histograms use inclusive upper bounds; null is overflow. Only public catalog kind names are retained; unknown kinds share a fixed bucket. Value classes and clone byte lengths contain no authored names, values or element identities. The collection clock measures record updates, not the complete opt-in branch or all profiler overhead

measurement_limits: Two observations per mode, fixed off/on/on/off order; no confidence interval or causal total-overhead bound
115 monitor observations exclude detected rustc/named pure_va processes, not all desktop work
Phase CPU has 10ms tick quantization plus stderr-pipe observation uncertainty
Lookup collection clock excludes the complete branch cost and other profiler work; API clocks include diagnostic work
Unknown catalog kinds deliberately share one scrubbed bucket; no exact kind/caller attribution follows from it
Lua self_samples count VM safepoint visits, not exclusive CPU time
